title: INSTRUMENTADOR CIRÚRGICO - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO
description:
CENTRO DO OLHO CARIOCA está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

  • Curso Completo de Técnico de Enfermagem e Instrumentação Cirúrgica
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses comprovada na função de Instrumentador Cirúrgico
  • Disponibilidade para atuar na escala 12X36.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
The Tax Analyst will support tax compliance and reporting activities with a focus on PIS/COFINS and Corporate Income Taxes, ensuring accurate calculations, proper tax treatment, and timely submission of obligations. The role involves analyzing tax impacts across revenues, costs, and expenses, supporting audits and tax planning initiatives, and collaborating closely with Accounting and Finance teams to ensure consistency and compliance, while monitoring legislative changes and contributing to process improvements and readiness for new tax requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Performing the calculation, review and compliance of PIS and COFINS, including tax credits analysis, input eligibility review, offset procedures, and preparation of EFD-Contribuições.

  • Analyzing tax impacts on revenues, costs and expenses to ensure proper tax treatment for PIS, COFINS, IRPJ and CSLL purposes.
  • Reconciling tax accounts related to PIS, COFINS, IRPJ and CSLL with accounting records and supporting monthly and year-end closing activities.
  • Preparing and reviewing tax returns and ancillary obligations (EFD-Contribuições, ECF, DCTF, PER/DCOMP and others related to the core taxes).
  • Supporting tax audits, inspections and assessments related primarily to PIS, COFINS and Corporate Income Taxes.
  • Assisting in tax planning initiatives, tax credit optimization and risk assessment related to the main taxes under responsibility.
  • Collaborating with Accounting and Finance teams to ensure proper tax classification and compliance.
  • Monitoring legislative changes and supporting the assessment of impacts arising from the Brazilian Tax Reform, contributing to the company’s readiness for new tax frameworks.
  • Demonstrating interest in understanding other taxes beyond the core scope of the position, supporting the team whenever necessary and contributing to a broader tax perspective

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Law;

Experience

title: Renewals Sales Manager, Americas
description:
Overview

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors. We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring a regional sales renewal team manager in North America to lead the renewals team in the region.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system – Ubuntu – to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software‑defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data centre, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long‑term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do – at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open sales team manager roles in every region.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer – a real understanding of customer needs, industry‑specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect – the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology – a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork – a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy – the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

What your day will look like

  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritise outreach and prospecting
  • Allocate portions of territory and accounts to sales representatives on your team
  • Identify and prioritise new logo accounts in your territory for account‑based marketing and prospecting
  • Ensure that sales representatives have high‑quality account plans for existing accounts and priority prospects
  • Monitor new pipeline development by your team, through outreach, prospecting, local marketing and industry events
  • Support contract closure to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Ensure your team maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Leadership and management skill
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective planning, organisation and reporting skill
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self‑discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team meetings in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Curriculum & Assessment Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Curriculum and Assessment manager will oversee and assist with data management, organization, and analysis for continuous quality improvement initiatives, student performance for annual assessment reporting, and external accreditation. The manager must be well‑versed in assessment measures, methodologies, and data analysis. The position will provide data management, data reporting and support to the Office of Academic Affairs staff in fulfilling the accreditation and evaluation functions of the dental school curriculum.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students, and staff within The College of Dentistry and University. External contacts include government agencies, corporations, foundations, vendors, other colleges and universities, visitors and the public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Support monitoring student progress, curriculum review, program self‑study, accreditation preparation, and continuous quality improvement functions.
  • Collect and analyze data/artifacts for direct and indirect assessment measures, including surveys, course, faculty and student data.
  • Assist with annual university assessment reporting including updating the Colleges assessment plan complete with what was done and the supporting documentation.
  • Ensure that there is an ongoing schedule for assessing areas in the College as identified by the Academic Dean.
  • Assist with self‑study coordination and reporting and accreditation site visit preparation, including coordinating, organizing, and formatting programmatic reports for reporting to identified entities.
  • Lead course evaluation process and data analysis.
  • Ensure the reliability and validity of assessment and survey instruments and recommend changes and enhancement as necessary.
  • Assist with the execution of a plan to cultivate a culture of assessment within the College of Dentistry based on data.
  • Harness assessment data to identify opportunities to improve program performance and achieve goals.
  • Coordinate curricular optimization with faculty and instructional design staff, completing the assessment “feedback loop.”
  • Produce ad hoc analyses, reports, graphs, and data as needed for both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design, distribute and maintain the electronic teaching evaluations.
  • Troubleshoot Examsoft issues and assist faculty and students with ExamSoft challenges.
  • Assist in developing statistical models to measure impact of learning support services on student achievement of intended learning outcomes.
  • Develop item analysis reports as necessary to help faculty evaluate the effectiveness of tests and test items.
  • Help conduct focus groups with students and or faculty and staff to get insight into practices that work and those that do not.
  • Stay abreast of current academic trends and policies regarding curricular and programmatic assessment and implementing effective assessment techniques at the college.
  • Participate as an ex‑officio member of identified committees.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Project management tools such as SharePoint.
  • Intermediate‑advanced data visualization.
  • Familiarity with importing/exporting from various databases and/or systems.
  • Familiarity with online survey management tools.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training to an audience with varying levels of technical understanding.
  • Experience supporting faculty in a teaching/learning environment.
  • Previous data analytics and database management experience.
  • Ability to manipulate data within and across MS Office products (e.g., conduct Microsoft Word email merges using mail lists in Excel, import data from Excel into Access).
  • Experience with LMS (ex. CANVAS) and assessment tools (ex. Examsoft) would be preferred.
  • Ability to establish and maintain productive and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the public.
  • Must have exceptional oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong team‑oriented, analytical, problem‑solving and decision‑making skills.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferably in education administration, data science, education, health care administration or public health preferred and 3 years of related experience.

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us, but with a different name:Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

How does Docplanner Tech fit here?

At Docplanner Tech we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and availability;
  • Implement and manage ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data quality, integrity, and consistency;
  • Collect, organize, and structure data from different sources (databases, APIs, files, etc.);

  • Work with relational and analytical databases, optimizing queries and performance;
  • Support the development and maintenance of Data Warehouses and Data Marts;
  • Create, enhance, and maintain existing dashboards and reports, ensuring performance, usability, and alignment with business rules;
  • Support and enhance BI tools such as Tableau, Looker Studio, and Apache Superset;
  • Develop automations and routines for data processing and control;
  • Monitor pipelines and data flows, identifying failures and proposing continuous improvements;
  • Document processes, architectures, pipelines, dashboards, and business rules;
  • Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to ensure accessible, reliable, and well‑presented data;
  • Participate in data projects end‑to‑end, including delivery, maintenance, and evolution of solutions;
  • Support technical and functional presentations for both technical and non‑technical audiences.

  • Business English (ability to participate in meetings, write documentation, and communicate with global teams);
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields;
  • 3 to 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or similar roles, focused on Data Engineering and BI (mid‑level);
  • Experience with relational and/or analytical databases such as Amazon Redshift, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL;
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with Python for building pipelines, automations, and supporting analysis;
  • Solid knowledge of database concepts: ER models (conceptual and logical);
  • Relational and dimensional data modeling;
  • Table structures, data types, and formats (CSV, JSON, Parquet);
  • DBMS knowledge;
  • Hands‑on experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools;
  • Experience with BI tools, including Apache Superset, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio, focused on dashboard creation and maintenance;
  • Experience with version control (Git);
  • Good communication, organization, and teamwork skills;
  • Analytical mindset with a focus on problem‑solving and continuous improvement

True flexibility and work‑life balance

Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in.

Our working hours are Monday through Friday, from 9am to 6pm.

Need to work beyond your usual hours? We have a time bank so that you can use those hours as time off later.

Additional paid holiday on your birthday and work anniversary.

Health comes first

Medical and Dental Assistance along with Group Life Insurance.

Access to the iFeel app, for emotional comfort, which combines traditional psychology with AI, helping you through those tough days.

A Gympass for you and 3 other people! Because working out alone is very boring, isn’t it?

Did you think your PET would be left out? Of course not! We offer a Pet Plan extending the care to your pet as well.

What will my tasks be?

  • Responsible for all maintenance tasks within the automation field, ensuring that operational requirements are met in accordance with governing documentation and company procedures.

title: Software Engineer, Cloud - Sustaining Engineering
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world\'s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer, Sustaining Engineering for ...

Location : This is a globally remote role.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require software engineering for upstream fixes. Our engineers have to be able to work productively at any level of the stack above the kernel, in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our enterprise customers, partners and Ubuntu itself. You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

This role entails

Responsibilities

  • Resolving complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintaining a close working relationship with Canonical\'s field, support and product engineering teams
  • Participating in upstream communities
  • Developing fixes, backporting patches, and working with upstream for inclusion
  • Reviewing code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrating good judgement in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritizing work and managing your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participating in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintaining clear, technical and concise communications
  • Working from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional experience as a software engineer
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Strong experience with Linux, OpenStack, Kubernetes or other cloud technologies
  • Strong development-level experience with Python, Go, C, C++ on Linux
  • Ability to troubleshoot with gdb and other tools
  • Familiarity with git source code repositories and branches
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, and experience with most of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, C, Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

The MSL will represent and reflect argenx’s values as a science-driven, patient-centric organization developing innovative medicines for patients, and always upholding the highest ethical standards. The MSL is critical in understanding the management of diseases of interest, mapping the patient journey, identifying unmet medical needs, data gaps, areas of collaboration, and sharing insights to enhance patient care. The MSL will work closely with the Medical Affairs team and cross-functionally with all relevant colleagues in argenx, locally and globally.**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES****Expert medical resource and collaboration and maintain a deep understanding of evolving healthcare trends across the relevant therapeutic landscape* Support the development and implementation of Strategic Territory Plans to intelligence, develop productive collaborations, engage in scientific exchange and ensure insights are shared within argenx* Identify potential high-impact medical research projects and publication opportunities, in line with argenx areas of interest* Ensure all relevant knowledge, including activities and interactions with important contacts, is systematically captured and disseminated within argenx as appropriate* Ensure all external interactions are conducted in accordance with argenx objectives, compliance policies and procedures as well as with established legal, regulatory and ethical standards**Cross-functional collaboration*** Ensure a close working relationship with all argenx functions* Support cross-functional teams to ensure operations are patient-focused, including rapidly responding to internal and external requests to discuss specific situations and challenges and provide medical affairs support to all stakeholders.* Develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with investigators and participating clinical study sites, leveraging their involvement in argenx‑sponsored research to enhance scientific engagement, while maintaining deep knowledge of study design to provide accurate, high‑quality scientific support when needed.**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES*** Demonstrated capability to accurately and critically evaluate medical and scientific thrives in a dynamic, complex, fast‑moving, and frequently changing environment* Project management skills with proactive planning, priority setting, and alignment-building* Highly outcome‑driven, ambitious, curious, quick to learn, and committed to continuous self‑development and constructive feedback* Passionate about contributing to and role‑modeling argenx’s corporate values of **co-creation, innovation, empowerment, excellence, and humility.****EDUCATION AND EXPERIEN****CE REQUIRED*** Scientific, healthcare or medical degrees (MS, PharmD, PhD, MD, RN, PA)* Significant field-based experience in the biopharmaceutical industry in medical affairs* Clinical experience in neurology, immunology and/or rare diseases is an advantage* Knowledge of regulations and practices related to industry interactions with healthcare professionals**OTHER*** Valid driver’s license* Ability for ≥50% travel* Bilingual*At argenx, all applicants are welcomed in an inclusive environment. title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager - Remote
description: About UsAt Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to dataFor more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.Why You’re HereYou’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.Com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.You’re here to:- Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.- Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.- Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.What You’ll Deliver- Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.- AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.- Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, dev.To, substack, and emerging platforms (which you’ll need to identify).- Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte’s social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting-edge social plays.- Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.Quantitative- New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)- Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)Qualitative- Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing- Speed and creativity of campaign execution- Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content- Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goalsWho You Are- Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.- Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.- AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.- Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.- Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.Requirements- 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products- Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills- Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.- (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer toolsTech You’ll work with- HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics- Figma, Notion, Google Workspace- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideationHow We WorkWe move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.As a new Zytan, you will:Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on

Buscamos um analista sênior de governança de identidades e acessos para atuar na camada estratégica e operacional da governança de acessos aos sistemas corporativos e ativos de tecnologia da informação e comunicação (tic), assegurando conformidade com políticas de segurança, requisitos de auditoria e princípios de mínimo privilégio e segregação de funções (sod).
o profissional será responsável por conduzir análises críticas, tomada de decisão baseada em risco e evolução contínua do modelo de identity governance & administration (iga), atuando em toda a camada de ciclo de vida de perfis e acessos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar como referência técnica na governança de perfis e acessos corporativos Governar acessos a sistemas críticos e ativos de TIC, garantindo aderência às políticas corporativas Analisar, validar e aprovar solicitações de acesso com base em risco de acesso, RBAC, princípio do mínimo privilégio e matriz de risco SoD Administrar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de perfis e acessos Atuar na governança e controle de contas sistêmicas, técnicas e privilegiadas Realizar análises investigativas relacionadas concessões indevidas, acessos excessivos ou incompatíveis Conduzir/apoiar revisões periódicas de acessos (recertificações) Monitorar indicadores e controles relacionados à gestão de acessos Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, incluindo ambientes regulados e controles SOX Elaborar relatórios executivos, dossiês de auditoria e evidências de conformidade Propor melhorias contínuas e automações nos processos de governança de acessos

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida em Governança de Identidades e Acessos (IAM / IGA) Experiência prática com IDM (Identity Management) e ciclo de vida de identidades Experiência com catálogo de perfis e acessos, Governança de contas sistêmicas e técnicas e Processos de recertificação de acessos Conhecimento avançado em: RBAC, SoD, Zero Trust, Vivência em ambientes sujeitos a auditoria e compliance (SOX desejável/obrigatório conforme contexto) Forte capacidade analítica e investigativa aplicada à análise de acessos Experiência com Excel avançado Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas da Informação ou áreas correlatas

title: ANALISTA COMERCIAL  I
description:
Descrição

Atuar no apoio ao executivo de contas na gestão do ciclo comercial, organizar as rotinas operacionais, assegurar o registro, acompanhamento e qualidade das informações e propostas comerciais no CRM, além de contribuir para a eficiência das interações com clientes e áreas interna.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Acompanhar o executivo de contas em visitas presenciais a clientes, apoiando na condução das agendas e no levantamento de informações relevantes; Atuar como principal responsável pela elaboração, organização e registro de propostas comerciais no CRM da companhia; Garantir a atualização e integridade das informações no CRM, incluindo pipeline, oportunidades, atividades e histórico de interações; Registrar atas das reuniões e agendas com clientes e áreas internas, assegurando clareza nos próximos passos e responsabilidades; Apoiar o executivo comercial em demandas operacionais, tanto com clientes quanto com áreas internas (financeiro, jurídico, operações, etc.); Realizar follow-ups com clientes e stakeholders internos para garantir o andamento das oportunidades; Apoiar na preparação de apresentações comerciais, relatórios e materiais de apoio; Monitorar prazos, propostas em andamento e etapas do funil de vendas; Contribuir para a padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos comerciais; Apoiar na organização de agendas, reuniões e eventos com clientes; Auxiliar na análise de dados comerciais e geração de relatórios de performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Marketing, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prévia em áreas comerciais, pré-vendas, atendimento ou suporte comercial; Familiaridade com sistemas de CRM (ex: Dynamics); Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de priorização; Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe;

title: Assistente De DP Pleno
description:
Descrição

Estamos buscando um(a) Assistente de DP Pleno para integrar nosso time e atuar com as rotinas completas de Administração de Pessoal. Procuramos um(a) profissional analítico(a), proativo(a) e com domínio técnico das atividades de DP. Realizar rotinas de folha de pagamento, adiantamento, férias, rescisões e pagamento de autônomos. Atender colaboradores e líderes para esclarecimento de dúvidas trabalhistas. Formação em Gestão de RH, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas afins. Experiência sólida nas rotinas de DP (folha, férias, rescisões e cálculos trabalhistas). Excel intermediário e domínio do Pacote Office. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita. Capacidade analítica e proatividade (itens inegociáveis).

title: Motorista de caminhão - cd rj
description:
Responsabilidades da Oportunidade
Já pensou como o seu trabalho pode impactar o dia a dia de milhões de brasileiros? Aqui, a gente pensa nisso todos os dias!
Temos em nossa fórmula colaboradores especiais e é com eles que aprendemos a dar o nosso melhor todos os dias, nos dedicando às pessoas, nos planejando, sendo eficientes e valorizando as diferenças, tendo o respeito como o nosso princípio ativo.
Está na cara que só falta uma coisa pra esse time ficar ainda mais completo: você! E aí, que tal ser protagonista dessa história junto com a gente?
Agora, além de nosso cliente, você pode ser do nosso time!

Quais serão seus desafios?
Transportar materiais, produtos e medicamentos;
Realizar check-list do caminhão verificando óleo do cárter, água do radiador, luzes do painel de comando, freio, lanterna, reservas, farol alto e baixo do painel de comando;
Verificar a quantidade de volumes de uma determinada loja;
Conferir lacre e tacógrafo dos caminhões;
Dirigir respeitando as leis de trânsito e os limites de velocidade;
Respeitar e dar preferência aos clientes que estão na loja;
Comunicar-se com a base através de teclado auto trac a cada período determinado, diminuindo esse período ao perceber veículos ou pessoas suspeitas em sua rota;
Verificar se todos os volumes foram entregues dando especial atenção ao malote e notas fiscais;
Validar se a rota determinada corresponde a nota fiscal;
Certificar se todo material está devidamente documentado para retornar.

O que consideramos importante para que você faça parte do nosso time?
- Ensino médio completo;
- CNH categoria D;
- Experiência na função;
- Disponibilidade de horário e viagens.
O que é legal que você saiba:
Tipo de contrato: CLT
Local de Trabalho: Rodovia Presidente Dutra 2749, Pavuna, RJ (CD Drogarias Pacheco)
Horário: Diurno

As diferenças fazem a composição da nossa receita! Aqui, todos são bem-vindos porque, para nós, o mais importante é você ser quem realmente quiser ser!

Se identificou? Então não perde tempo e embarque nessa com a gente!

Nossa força está nas pessoas que colocam saúde em primeiro lugar, atuam com   ética, colaboração e respeito às diferenças. Junte-se a nós e seja protagonista na transformação da jornada de saúde de quem   confia na gente.
Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos   autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo   ou deficiência. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência   (PCD).

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Requisitos

Requisitos:

O que esperamos de você:

  • Espírito colaborativo, boa comunicação e disposição para trabalhar em equipe;

Não é necessário ter experiência! Valorizamos sua vontade de aprender e crescer com a gente.

title: Analista de Governança
description:
Sobre nós:

A MDC tem como propósito fazer da energia sustentável uma geradora de valor.

Investimos em ativos energéticos com presença em toda a cadeia de gás natural, biometano, energia elétrica renovável e vapor através de biomassa. Oferecemos soluções energéticas para negócios que almejam uma economia de baixo carbono, proporcionando estabilidade e valor sustentável a longo prazo.

Conheça um pouco da nossa empresa em 

Queremos sempre fazer mais e melhor, com segurança e com pessoas engajadas que não desistem dos desafios. Chegamos até aqui com muito esforço e trabalho em equipe. Dedicamos nossa energia para desenvolver negócios sustentáveis. Agimos como donos e estimulamos a inovação.

Buscamos criar um ambiente inclusivo, justo, seguro e respeitoso para todos, onde cada colaborador tenha acesso às mesmas oportunidades de desenvolvimento. Em nossa Companhia, não aceitamos discriminação ou preconceito, sejam eles de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, raça, nacionalidade, condição física ou quaisquer outros. Valorizamos nossa gente, nossa diversidade, fortalecendo o time. Criamos espaços para autenticidade.

Sobre a vaga: 

ANALISTA DE GOVERNANÇA

Prestar suporte às atividades de governança corporativa e rotinas societárias da Companhia, incluindo a organização de reuniões da Diretoria, Conselho de Administração e Assembleias, elaboração e controle de atas e documentos societários, gestão e controle de procurações, bem como a administração e atualização do portal e dos repositórios de documentos do departamento Jurídico.

Principais atribuições/responsabilidades:

  • Organizar agendas, pautas e materiais das reuniões da Diretoria, Conselho de Administração e Assembleias;
  • Elaborar convocações, agendas e pautas de reuniões dos órgãos de governança;
  • Atuar como secretário(a) de reuniões, elaborar atas, listas de presença, registros de deliberações e consolidar materiais das áreas para composição dos books de reunião;                              
  • Controlar o calendário anual de governança;
  • Acompanhar as deliberações e encaminhar as decisões às áreas responsáveis;
  • Preparar minutas de atas, acompanhar coleta de assinaturas e formalização de documentos societários;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e conferência de atos societários, contratos sociais, procurações e documentos corporativos;
  • Organizar e manter atualizada a base documental societária da companhia;                    
  • Controlar o arquivamento físico e digital de documentos jurídicos e societários;      
  • Atualizar sistemas jurídicos, bases documentais e planilhas de controle societário;                    
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas no fornecimento de documentos societários;                         
  • Participar de processos de due diligence;                                                     
  • Realizar pesquisas em legislação, doutrina e jurisprudência;
  • Manter interface com cartórios, Juntas Comerciais, escritórios de advocacia, contabilidade e prestadores de serviços paralegais.

Requisitos:

  • Superior em Direito, Administração, Secretariado Executivo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia consistente em secretariado de órgãos de governança, suporte societário ou funções paralegais, com pelo menos 4 anos de atuação;
  • Vivência com organização de reuniões executivas, elaboração de atas ou gestão documental societária;
  • Experiência com portais de governança ou sistemas jurídicos / GED;
  • Conhecimento das práticas do IBGC;
  • Desejável cursos ou especialização em Direito Societário ou Governança Corporativa;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Word, Excel e PowerPoint).

Habilidades e Competências:

  • Proatividade, senso de prioridade e gestão de tempo;
  • Organização;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;                  
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva;
  • Discrição, ética e elevado padrão de confidencialidade;
  • Capacidade de articulação com executivos e conselheiros.

title: Tecnico de manutencão elétrica jr
description:

O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do Estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

title: Auxiliar de operador de sistemas remotos i rio de janeiro (presencial)
description:
Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.

Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar na área de Operações Remotas, contribuindo diretamente para as atividades embarcadas e para a operação de sistemas e equipamentos de alta tecnologia utilizados em projetos marítimos. Essa posição é fundamental para garantir o suporte técnico necessário às operações, assegurando precisão, confiabilidade e segurança na execução das atividades offshore. O(a) profissional terá papel estratégico no monitoramento, na coleta de dados e no funcionamento contínuo dos sistemas remotos, fortalecendo a excelência operacional e impulsionando a inovação dentro da OceanPact.

Responsabilidades 
  • Auxiliar nas operações da empresa em regime embarcado;
  • Prestar suporte direto à operação de sistemas remotos;
  • Atuar com veículos aéreos, de superfície e submarinos, autônomos ou remotamente operados;
  • Apoiar a operação de boias oceânicas e outros instrumentos utilizados em Operações Remotas e P&D;
  • Realizar monitoramento e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais;
  • Executar procedimentos técnicos conforme orientações da equipe de engenharia e operações;
  • Registrar informações técnicas e operacionais para fins de acompanhamento e análise;
  • Contribuir para a eficiência, segurança e bom funcionamento dos equipamentos e processos.
Requisitos 

Obrigatórios:

  • Pacote Office Intermediário
  • Curso técnico em uma das áreas acima mencionada;
  • Curso de Marinheiro de convés ou Marinheiro;
  • Curso Mecânico Diesel.

Desejáveis:

  • CBSP;
  • T-HUET.
  Formação Acadêmica
  • Técnico em Mecânica; Técnico em Eletrônica; Técnico em Eletrotécnica ou Técnico em Automação.
Local de trabalho
  • Cidade Universitária - Ilha do Governador;
  • Disponibilidades para embarques ocasionais.
O que buscamos

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade

  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência

  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento

  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas

  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias

  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

O que oferecemos

  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação

  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore

title: Analista de imigração - rio de janeiro
description:
Você na Deloitte

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando Analista de Imigração. Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Desenvolver atividades voltadas para a área de Imigração;
  • Apoiar, elaborar e revisar processos de autorização de residência;
  • Controlar vencimentos de vistos e documentação, realizar atualizações em sistemas e dar suporte a respostas de consultas escritas e orais;
  • Realizar atendimentos externos em Órgãos Públicos e Consulados;
  • Acompanhar estrangeiros e prestar atendimento direto ao cliente;
  • Solucionar dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre processos migratórios para o Brasil e América Latina.

Prezamos pelos In-Person Moments that Matter (momentos presenciais que importam) e, com isso, o modelo de trabalho adotado é o Digital Workplace, ou seja, em trabalho híbrido (remoto e presencial) com frequência de idas presenciais adaptadas de acordo com a necessidade da área. No Tax & Legal, o time atua 3(três) vezes por semana em formato presencial, sejam nas dependências físicas dos escritórios da Deloitte ou de nossos clientes.  

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências. 

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito. 
Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto. 


O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Formação superior completa;
  • Espanhol desejável (nível intermediário a avançado);
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidade para atendimentos externos, fora do escritório, em órgãos governamentais (Polícia Federal, Detran, etc.) e Consulados.
O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional 

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes. 

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar 

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa! 
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social  

(Mais) Benefícios 

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar* 
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida* 
  • Cartão Multibenefícios* 

 
*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.


Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva 
Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações.  Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.  

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Comandante a330
description:
Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:


Formação


  • Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)


Experiência


  • Experiência superior a 5 anos na função e na aeronave.


Certificações Obrigatórias


  • Licença de Piloto de Linha Aérea (PLA);
  • Certificado de Habilitação Técnica (CHT) para o Airbus A330;
  • Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA) válido;
  • Passaporte brasileiro válido por mais de 6 (seis) meses;
  • Vistos americanos B1, B2 e D válidos.


Conhecimentos Técnicos


  • Regulamentação aeronáutica aplicável (RBAC 121 e CBA);
  • Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança Operacional (SGSO);
  • Procedimentos operacionais da aeronave A330;
  • Operação de aeronaves widebody e voos de longo curso.


Idiomas


  • Proficiência na língua inglesa (ICAO) 4 ou superior.


IMPORTANTE: o local de trabalho será definido após a aprovação no processo seletivo. É necessário possuir disponibilidade para mudança.

Missão do Cargo


Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.


Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.


Autoridade


  • Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação;
  • Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis;
  • Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança;
  • Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo;
  • Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados;
  • Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem;
  • Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle;
  • Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário;
  • Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica.



Segurança Operacional


  • Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final;
  • Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento;
  • Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo;
  • Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos;
  • Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV.;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;
  • Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa.


Gestão da Tripulação


  • Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação;
  • Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo;
  • Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists;
  • Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.


Conformidade e Registros


  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;
  • Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais;
  • Assegurar os registros de ocorrências a bordo, incluindo eventos médicos, nascimentos e óbitos, conforme regulamentação aplicável;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental.


Cabine e Passageiros


  • Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação;
  • Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando;
  • Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência.

description:
